answer: One principal gets one focus each epoch; only the focused head accrues tenure from nadir, and heads rotated onto that focus are folded as one. A head counts at zenith = 16 straight focused epochs. Leaving focus early resets it to nadir and burns pigment equal to the lost streak squared, so keeping k clones at weight means serial focus: the kth needs 16k elapsed attested epochs before it counts (first 16, tenth 160); parallel wallets share no focus.
